statement: For every finite poset R and every order-convex P subseteq R x Q_1 with horizontal sections P_0 and P_1, 2 w(P) >= w(P_0 x Q_1) + w(P_1 x Q_1). Consequently, for all integers n,k >= 0 and every order-convex P subseteq Q_n, w(P x Q_k) >= w(Q_(n+k)) |P| 2^(-n), including empty P and empty sections.
contribution: A complete componentwise comparison-graph repair of the key two-layer lemma, with both constructed antichains audited in every comparison direction and the downstream induction checked independently. It also gives an exact three-element-chain failure of the source's natural undefined-C sorting interpretation; this failure concerns that proof step, not the lemma. Exhaustive exact checks through five-element ambient posets support the proof. No novelty or priority beyond this precise repair is asserted.
